calculation.description: For each tradable instrument, negate the mean of its last three completed-session open-to-close returns; higher values indicate stronger recent intraday weakness and a contrarian long signal. At a decision date use only completed sessions through the prior day.

validation.regime_notes: Positive daily IC and ICIR in 2020-22 (+0.0337/+0.1024), 2023-24 (+0.0437/+0.1307), 2025 through 2026-06 (+0.0449/+0.1310), and online 2026-07-01 through 2027-02-24 (+0.0377/+0.1166). Small 15-asset cross-section warrants conservative inference.
